# CI/CD — Level 3

This directory is where the project's CI/CD workflows will live (Level 3 of
the Midnight Builder Challenge).

Planned workflows:

- **compile**: run `compact compile` and fail on errors
- **test**: run `npm test` (in-memory contract tests) and `npm run test:e2e`
  against a funded Preview wallet when secrets are available

Nothing to see here yet — Level 1 scope only.
